segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: All right. So, how do you actually warm up your Facebook profile?

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Facebook profile is the most straightforward one, since you're using the actual real profiles.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Facebook just wants to see engagement that it's a real thing.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So all you do, you log in, spend maybe five to 10 minutes on each profile, these three profiles,

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: uh look, for a whole week, just engaging with people.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Let's say, I go on my Facebook feed, I see this, click like, just comment, "Nice."

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Literally that's all you need to do: like, comment, share.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: So Facebook sees that you're actually using the platform and engaging, and you're a real person.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: That's all you need to do for the Facebook profile.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: There's really nothing else to warm up your profile besides this.
